questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how this code models shipments and their tracking events in MongoDB? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
The same event (same id) is delivered twice by the carrier integration. What happens on the second delivery?
choices: The events insert fails with a duplicate key error, the transaction aborts so eventCount is not incremented again, and recordEvent returns false
eventCount is incremented a second time, but the event document is stored only once
A second event document is stored with an auto-generated _id and the embedded window shows it twice
The error is rethrown to the router and the client receives a 500

questions.prompt: A shipment accumulates 10,000 tracking events over its life. What does GET /shipments/:id return and cost?
choices: All 10,000 events, read from the embedded array in one large document
The 50 latest events plus totalEvents 10000, served from one small document read
The 50 latest events, found by querying shipment_events and counting with countDocuments
An error once the document passes the 16 MB limit

questions.prompt: Which statement about the shipments index on { carrierId: 1, status: 1, lastEventAt: -1 } is correct for listStuck?
choices: It is unused, because the query also sorts and sorting always needs a separate index
It only helps if the query also filters on trackingNumber
It serves the equality filters on carrierId and status and the range and sort on lastEventAt
It is unused because lastEventAt is updated with $max, which bypasses indexes
